4921-accept.name: Mankrik
4921-accept.text:
We battled in a small $r camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.

I awoke to a $r $c tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.

Please, $c, find some sign of my wife.
4921-accept.title: Lost in Battle
